download_rep_eli5_model: download the rep_eli5_ctxt_and_label model to a specified datapath using the build function
run_download_function: run the download function to fetch the rep_eli5_ctxt_and_label_v1 tgz archive
build_rep_eli5_data: build the rep_eli5_ctxt_and_label dataset by calling download with a target datapath
review_download_function: review the download function that fetches the ELI5 context and label repetition unlikelihood model
summarize_module: summarize the rep_eli5_ctxt_and_label module which provides a download function for the ELI5 model
